newsitem.title: USA: CS First Boston buys Wall Street building - NYT.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston buys Wall Street building - NYT.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston has bought 55 Wall Street, a historic building in the heart of New York's financial district, for $21.15 million, the New York Times said.
In Wednesday's edition, the Times said the investment firm was considering using the building as a ballroom, and possibly a luxury hotel or apartments.
The 155-year-old building was originally the Merchants Exchange and later used as New York's customs house and headquarters of National City Bank.
Real estate tycoon Donald Trump had considered buying the building, but backed away from a deal about four months ago.
